[LIMP.1.1] An **import** brings top-level declarations from
another DS file (the **library**) into the current file's
resolution scope. After `import ha`, names declared at the
top level of `ha.ds` resolve under the qualified form
`ha.<name>` ([LGRA.2.10.4]). After `from ha import light`, the
name `light` resolves bare in the importing file. A library
must be imported for any of its symbols to be referenced.
